faqs.a:
(a)
Record.
The hearing held by the council pursuant to
section 91-30
shall be open to the public, and a record of the proceedings shall be made. Any evidence
               (including any testimony) which, in the discretion of the city council, is relevant
               to the organization of the proposed title 32 district shall be considered.
(b)
Postponement.
The city council may postpone or continue the hearing until a later time or date
               by announcing such postponement or continuance of the hearing or by posting notice
               at the originally scheduled time and place of the hearing, and no further publication
               or mailing of the notice shall be necessary.
(c)
Participation by interested parties.
All interested parties as defined in C.R.S. § 32-1-204 shall be authorized to address
               the city council.
(
Ord. No. 4815
, § 1, 10-3-2022)
